title: fix(runtime): a dispatcher door is served only by the request's own kernel
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:托管多环境主机上,评论、审批链接页、Webhook 重投、入站自动化钩子等入口只由本次请求所在环境自己的服务来处理;该环境没装对应插件时,入口如实回答"尚未提供"。单环境部署用户无感。
- 为什么做:加固多环境部署下这几个入口的服务归属规则。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某环境里本应可用的入口回答"尚未提供",不会写错数据;改动小,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

A dispatcher door is served only by the request's own kernel.

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.ts` gains `readDoorSlot`, the one reader every dispatcher door bridge reads the member it forwards to through. It reads the slot off the request's own kernel (`getRequestKernelService`, the reader the personal-view, attachment and print bridges already used) and treats a lookup that throws as an empty slot.
- The comment doors (`comments.ts`), the approval action page (`approvals.ts`), the webhook redeliver door (`webhooks.ts`) and the inbound automation hook (`automation-hooks.ts`) now read their member through it. A request kernel without the slot answers the door's existing typed not-available answer, `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, in the request's language, exactly as an empty slot already did.
- On a host with one kernel the request's kernel is that kernel, so nothing changes there.

First files to read, by risk:

1. `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.ts` — the `readDoorSlot` function, the only new code path.
2. `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-hooks.ts` — the one-line reader swap at the top of `handleInboundHookRequest`.
3. `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.test.ts` — the new last top-level `describe`.

## Tests

A new top-level `describe` in `own-door-bridge.test.ts` (the door bridges' shared harness), "a dispatcher door is served only by the request's own kernel", driven through the real `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()` with a `kernel-resolver` that places each request on its own kernel:

- for each of the seven door bridges (comments, approvals, webhooks, automation-hooks, personal-views, attachments, print), twice (a request kernel whose lookup throws, and one that answers nothing): the door answers `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` and a member registered elsewhere is never called (14 cases);
- for each of the seven: with the slot on the request kernel, the request kernel's member serves the call (7 preservation cases);
- a completeness pin: every module under `src/domains/` that answers a door's not-available `501` reads the slot that answer guards through `readDoorSlot`, found by scanning the directory rather than listed, so a new bridge reading its member any other way fails it; and the reader itself reads the request kernel's slot and nothing else.

Reverse verification (each run on the committed fix, then restored and proved byte-identical to `HEAD`):

- the four bridge reads reverted to their previous reader: 9 red (the 8 not-available cases of those four doors, and the completeness pin), the 7 preservation cases and the 3 untouched bridges green;
- `readDoorSlot` itself reading through the other reader: 15 red (all 14 not-available cases and the completeness pin).

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

All at head `da21c49d9db` (the branch merged with `origin/main`), after rebuilding `@objectstack/runtime`'s dependency closure:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` — exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `own-door-bridge`, `comments`, `approvals-act`, `webhooks-redeliver`, `automation-hooks`, `scoped-service-miss-attribution`, `domain-501-language-37811` and `http-dispatcher` tests — `Test Files 8 passed (8)`, `Tests 461 passed (461)`.
- Reverse verification, on the committed fix: four bridge reads reverted — `Tests 9 failed | 63 passed (72)`; the shared reader reverted — `Tests 15 failed | 57 passed (72)`; each restored and proved equal to the `HEAD` blob by `git hash-object`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 64): 61 exit 0; three NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI — `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, it needs a full `pnpm build`), `check:query-options-erasure` and `check:type-check-debt` (stopped at a 300 s local cap on a shared box). The ratchet families and the source-text gates were re-run on the merged head, all exit 0.
- The full `@objectstack/runtime` suite was not run locally (the shared verify lock was held by another run for over 18 minutes); `Test Core` runs it on this PR.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The preservation cases are green before and after the fix by design: they pin that the request kernel's own member keeps serving.
- No shared-kernel (scoped-registration) mode is affected: every slot these doors read is registered as a plain singleton by its plugin.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/own-door-bridge.test.ts` — expect every case under "a dispatcher door is served only by the request's own kernel" to pass.
